name: Text as a whole
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EU) 2021/1058 and (EU) 2021/1056 as regards specific measures to address strategic challenges in the context of the mid-term review
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to widen the EU's regional funds so they can pay for defence and security projects, not just traditional regional development. Money could go to factories making defence equipment, roads and bridges usable by both armies and civilians, shelters and other crisis-ready public buildings, energy and water infrastructure, and affordable housing. The Parliament also asks for more generous EU co-funding, faster advance payments to Member States, and extra help for regions near Russia, Belarus and Ukraine.

- **What changes:** Regional funds may pay for defence, dual-use infrastructure, civil preparedness, housing, energy and water projects.
- **Who it affects:** Member States, regions, local authorities, small firms and defence-related industries.
- **What happens next:** Parliament negotiates this position with EU governments before the law can take effect.
